items.title: Wells Fargo (WFC) Commits $1 Million To Affordable Housing In Wyoming
items.summary: Wells Fargo (NYSE:WFC) has awarded a $1 million grant to the Wyoming Housing Network to support affordable housing and workforce development initiatives in Wyoming. The funding targets rural communities in the state, with a focus on addressing housing shortages and training local workers in construction related skills. The grant is intended to back new construction technologies and workforce programs that align with Wells Fargo's broader community impact efforts beyond its core banking...

items.title: Goldman, Wells Say Treasury Buybacks Unlikely to Cut Long Rates
items.summary: Interest-rate strategists at Goldman Sachs Group Inc., Wells Fargo & Co. and other Wall Street firms said the US Treasury Department’s bond buybacks will do little to reverse the jump in long-term yields.

items.title: Canada Goose Shares Slide After Wells Fargo Downgrade
items.summary: Canada Goose (NYSE:GOOS) shares fell 5. 5% in pre-market trading after Wells Fargo downgraded the luxury apparel company to “underweight” from “equal weight,” citing a series of structural challenges that could weigh on its near-term performance.

items.title: Wells Fargo Conceives a High Rating for the Fertility-Benefits Biz
items.summary: What employees really want are fertility benefits, and there’s a market for providing them that’s underserved.  Progyny provides family-focused services to about 7 million patients at more than 600 companies, but Wells Fargo sees a potential market of 156 million.  The decade-old company made nearly $1.3 billion in revenue in the past fiscal year, up 10%, as it continued expanding beyond basic fertility services.
